svg.title: azure-deployment-overview
svg.desc: Proposed Field & File deployment, fixed baseline c179b1c plus approved Foundry-hosted agents. F denotes local foundation templates, P proposed workloads, E external actors and systems. No deployed resources are asserted. Logical connections are grouped by labelled flow IDs; private integration is pending.

text.tspan: All solution components · approved Foundry-hosted direction · D1–D7
Entra ID: workforce • national eID: farmers • optional External ID broker: approval pending
AKS Workload Identity / managed identities / RBAC • case & parcel permissions enforced by APIs
Customer VNet · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Standard
F: private cluster foundation | P: application workloads, Gateway / Route / TLS
interactive-agent-api / agent-worker: Foundry adapters only; custom runtime agents live in Foundry
crop-scoring adapter: ML job submission / versioned prediction-result validation • copernicus-fetcher • feature-worker
guidance-indexer • audit-pack-worker • payment-system-adapter • optional drone-evidence-worker / notification worker
Raw uploads go directly to quarantine Blob; accepted prediction results register through evidence-api
Customer-owned Azure PaaS & durable state · proposed workloads
Immutable policy: pending retention / legal approval
Only authorised APIs write; no direct agent DB writes
Azure Event Grid: object / scan notifications
Not the authoritative case or evidence record
Durable action history registered through AKS APIs
Decision Support Agent (baseline: Discrepancy Resolution Agent)
Accepts registered evidence + calibrated ML rating
Recommends action; invokes typed AKS tools only
Four other roles • bounded analytical / drafting work
Runtime agents ≠ the nine delivery-team agents
Approved EU Regional / EU Data Zone; geography TBD
Retrieved text is untrusted input, not deterministic rule authority
Training jobs → model registry → managed batch scoring
Dataset / feature / calibration / model versions; as-of cutoff
Crop rating + quality + uncertainty / UNKNOWN → registered result
Optional online endpoint / separate drone vision batch model
Sentinel feature classifier is not a raw-drone image classifier
Private agent ↔ AKS integration and selected-region support: pending validation
LOCAL IaC FOUNDATION · F = templates exist; acceptance / deployment pending
Sweden Central foundation • private AKS; system / user pools; NAP disabled • workload services above are proposed, not in WP-001
P: App Insights; AI / ML traces
LEGEND F foundation-template P proposed workload E external • solid: logical flow dashed: identity / integration pending or independent route
C1 Authenticated user channels → AKS front / APIs
C2 call: Foundry → AKS tools; result: AKS → Foundry (D1)
C3 AKS APIs → versioned case, evidence & action records (D3)
C4 AKS workers ↔ Copernicus discovery / processing
C5 Registry reads; approved treasury handoff + reconciliation
C6 / C7 ML jobs → ML; versioned results → AKS adapter → evidence
M1 / C8 Foundry model inference / approved guidance (D2)
C9 Service Bus / Event Grid ↔ evidence & worker flows
C10 / N1 Shared telemetry / private-access dependencies
Proposed deployment · fictional Hungarian CAP case · baseline c179b1c + approved hosting change · author r5 · independent review pending
